name: RT-11 V5.3
description: DEC's RT-11 V5.3 (1985), the small, fast single-user operating system that put PDP-11s into laboratories: a keyboard monitor with a "." prompt, the KED editor, MACRO-11, LINK and a full set of utilities. The SimH software kit's distribution disk on an RL02; its first boot answers the installation questions automatically and reboots as RT-11FB.

license.name: Mentec PDP-11 hobbyist licence
license.summary: Personal, non-commercial use only, on a PDP-11 emulator (Mentec's licence for RT-11 V5.3, RSTS/E V9.6, RSX-11M V4.3, RSX-11M-PLUS V3.0 and earlier). It does not allow redistribution, so the disk image is downloaded from its original source after you accept the licence.

shutdown: RT-11 needs no shutdown: it writes directories immediately. Make sure no program is running (the "." prompt is showing; Ctrl+C twice stops a program) and switch off.
notes:
## Log in

No login: RT-11 is a single-user system. Type commands at the `.` prompt of the keyboard monitor; `HELP` explains them (`HELP DIRECTORY`; press Return for the next page, Ctrl+C to stop). The boot sets the date and time; RT-11 V5.3 only accepts 1972-1999, so the year is the 19xx year whose calendar matches today's. Lower case input is converted to upper case.

## Things to try

* `SHOW CONFIGURATION`, `SHOW DEVICES`, `DIRECTORY`, `TYPE V5NOTE.TXT`, `DATE`, `TIME`.
* Write, assemble, link and run a MACRO-11 program: `COPY TT: HELLO.MAC`, type the program, press Ctrl+Z, then `MACRO HELLO`, `LINK HELLO` and `RUN HELLO`:

  ```
          .TITLE  HELLO
          .MCALL  .PRINT,.EXIT
  START:  .PRINT  #MSG
          .EXIT
  MSG:    .ASCIZ  /Hello from MACRO-11!/
          .END    START
  ```
* A light chaser for the front panel: create LIGHTS.MAC the same way, `MACRO LIGHTS`, `LINK LIGHTS`, `RUN LIGHTS`, and turn the DATA knob to DISPLAY REGISTER. Ctrl+C twice stops it.

  ```
          .TITLE  LIGHTS
  START:  MOV     #1,R0
  LOOP:   MOV     R0,@#177570
          CLR     R1
  1$:     SOB     R1,1$
          ASL     R0
          BNE     LOOP
          BR      START
          .END    START
  ```
* RT-11 never executes a WAIT instruction: its idle loop spins, so the RUN lamp stays lit and the ADDRESS lamps show the loop. That is why this system runs at authentic speed (about 1 MIPS) by default; at fast speed it keeps a host core 100 % busy.

## Shut down

Nothing to shut down: RT-11 writes directories immediately. Go back to the `.` prompt (Ctrl+C twice stops a running program) and switch off.
